title: Ella Langley, Geese and Don Toliver among the Grammy Best New Artist nominees
summary: Eight acts are in the running for one of the night's four biggest awards.
body:
The eight nominees for Best New Artist at the 2027 Grammy Awards were announced on Monday 16 November.

The nominees

  • Angine de Poitrine
  • Geese
  • Ella Langley
  • Slayyyter
  • Sienna Spiro
  • Don Toliver
  • Remi Wolf
  • The Womack Sisters

Langley is the best-known name on the list. Her song "Choosin' Texas" has spent a record 27 weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, and she has seven Grammy nominations in all.

Billboard reports that 331 artists were eligible for the category this year.

Sources: the Recording Academy, CNN, Billboard.
